definition: Took the place of something else, especially through force or unfair means.
author: Matthew Gregory Lewis
quote: The burst of transport was past: Ambrosio’s lust was satisfied; Pleasure fled, and Shame usurped her seat in his bosom.
example_sentence: The new app quickly usurped the old one on every phone.
